canonical.name: Memory and recall
canonical.scope: Train working memory appropriately and use mnemonics, retrieval cues, stories, and spaced review for long-term memory.
canonical.evidence_of_progress: Recalls relevant knowledge without depending entirely on recognition or external lookup.
